UPSSSC Junior Assistant 12/2024 Typing Test New Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Short Details : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the typing test exam date for the Junior Assistant Post. This recruitment was released for 3284 posts. The applications for UPSSSC Junior Assistant Recruitment 2024 were accepted from December 23, 2024, to January 22, 2025. The typing test examination is scheduled to be conducted on November 13, 2026. Candidates who had appeared this examination can download their UPSSSC Junior Assistant 12/2024 Typing Test Exam Date 2026 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 26 November 2024
  • Application Start Date : 23 December 2024
  • Last Date : 22 January 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 January 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 29 January 2025
  • Exam Date : 01 February 2026
  • Exam City Details : 22 February 2026
  • Admit Card : 28 January 2026
  • Answer Key : 02 February 2026
  • Revised Answer Key : 13 June 2026
  • Result : 15 September 2026
  • Typing Test Exam Date : 13 November 2026
  • Check the Important Links section
  • After clicking on the link, candidates will be redirected to the Dashboard page.

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, BC : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Divyang) : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
